title: Paperhangers
description: Cover interior walls or ceilings of rooms with decorative wallpaper or fabric, or attach advertising posters on surfaces such as walls and billboards. May remove old materials or prepare surfaces to be papered.

tasks.text: Smooth strips or sections of paper with brushes or rollers to remove wrinkles and bubbles and to smooth joints.
Trim rough edges from strips, using straightedges and trimming knives.
Trim excess material at ceilings or baseboards, using knives.
Mark vertical guidelines on walls to align strips, using plumb bobs and chalk lines.
Cover interior walls and ceilings of rooms with decorative wallpaper or fabric, using hand tools.
Place strips or sections of paper on surfaces, aligning section edges and patterns.
Fill holes, cracks, and other surface imperfections preparatory to covering surfaces.
Smooth rough spots on walls and ceilings, using sandpaper.
Set up equipment, such as pasteboards and scaffolds.
Apply acetic acid to damp plaster to prevent lime from bleeding through paper.
Apply adhesives to the backs of paper strips, using brushes, or dunk strips of prepasted wallcovering in water, wiping off any excess adhesive.
Apply sizing to seal surfaces and maximize adhesion of coverings to surfaces.
Remove old paper, using water, steam machines, or solvents and scrapers.
Apply thinned glue to waterproof porous surfaces, using brushes, rollers, or pasting machines.
Mix paste, using paste powder and water, and brush paste onto surfaces.
Remove paint, varnish, dirt, and grease from surfaces, using paint remover and water soda solutions.
Check finished wallcoverings for proper alignment, pattern matching, and neatness of seams.

clusters.label: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Measure and cut strips from rolls of wallpaper or fabric, using shears or razors.
Measure surfaces or review work orders to estimate the quantities of materials needed.
Staple or tack advertising posters onto fences, walls, billboards, or poles.

skills.name: Active Listening
skills.def: Giving full attention to what other people are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times.

skills.name: Speaking
skills.def: Talking to others to convey information effectively.

skills.name: Coordination
skills.def: Adjusting actions in relation to others' actions.

skills.name: Critical Thinking
skills.def: Using logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems.

skills.name: Time Management
skills.def: Managing one's own time and the time of others.

skills.name: Monitoring
skills.def: Monitoring/Assessing performance of yourself, other individuals, or organizations to make improvements or take corrective action.

skills.name: Complex Problem Solving
skills.def: Identifying complex problems and reviewing related information to develop and evaluate options and implement solutions.

skills.name: Judgment and Decision Making
skills.def: Considering the relative costs and benefits of potential actions to choose the most appropriate one.

skills.name: Social Perceptiveness
skills.def: Being aware of others' reactions and understanding why they react as they do.

skills.name: Word processing software
skills.def: Software to create, edit, store, or print documents. Examples: Google Docs, Microsoft Word.

skills.name: Spreadsheet software
skills.def: Software to create or edit numbers or text organized into rows and columns of cells. May include formulas which recalculate values based on other cells. Examples: Microsoft Excel.

skills.name: Project management software
skills.def: Software to plan, organize, staff, or control the completion of a product or set of tasks. Examples: Construction Software Center EasyEst, On Center Quick Bid, PlanSwift.

skills.name: Accounting software
skills.def: Software to enable business functions relating to accounting, such as recording transactions or managing budgets. Examples: A-Systems JobView, Turtle Creek Software Goldenseal.

skills.name: Graphics or photo imaging software
skills.def: Software to draw or manipulate images. May adjust colors, add text, or apply special effects. Examples: Corel Painter.

skills.name: Enterprise application integration software
skills.def: Software to connect different business systems to improve scalability or streamline work flows. Examples: Electronic data interchange EDI software.
